claims.claim: The existing Product Intelligence CLI remains the sole CLI and exposes exactly evidence, catalog, ask, and discover; TASK-145 behavior is preserved and root main.py / AgentController remain untouched.

`discover` requires exact Human query, one-or-more ordered shopee/tiktok platform selections, and explicit CDP endpoint, while exposing only optional shortlist_size beyond those required inputs and no implicit platform/browser/scoring/provider choice.

`discover` constructs exactly one existing PlaywrightBrowserManager with cdp_endpoint and injects that exact object into one existing adapter and one canonical DiscoveryRequest per selected platform in Human order, with duplicate platforms preserved for existing orchestrator fail-closed validation.

One timezone-aware UTC timestamp is captured exactly once and the exact same object is supplied as observed_at and evaluated_at to exactly one existing orchestrate_discovery call together with the exact plans and unchanged shortlist_size.
The CLI never calls adapters, CandidateRanker, scoring/normalization, or platform parsing directly; M2 orchestration/ranking authority remains unchanged.
Successful discovery returns exit 0 and exactly the existing OrchestrationResult.to_dict() JSON representation without new recommendation, truth, approval, or ranking semantics.

The constructed browser manager is cleaned exactly once; orchestration failure remains the primary error if cleanup also fails, while cleanup-only failure after successful orchestration fails closed through the sanitized CLI boundary.
Discovery/orchestration/browser failures use the existing bounded sanitized error surface with no traceback, nested cause, cookie/token/raw-page leakage; module import remains side-effect-free.

TASK-146 performs no approval, enqueue, ingestion, evidence/catalog mutation, family/variant admission, provider/grounded QA, AgentLoop, Drive, background service, retry/fallback, or P5.3/P6 behavior; focused offline tests plus existing M2/CDP regressions prove the boundary.
Documentation records P5.1 CLOSED, P5.2 as TASK-146 live-capable/offline-verified discovery-shortlist presentation, P5.3 still unimplemented, overall P5 IN PROGRESS, and P6 not current.
